variants.headline: Colony openly defies its charter
variants.sub: Open defiance of the charter is taking place in {colony}.
variants.body:
The colony is openly defying its charter. The defiance is established; a particular punishment or response is not. An assessment of {target} should distinguish the political and legal question posed by that stance from an invented account of what the home world has done in reply.

The gazette records the defiance without assuming an amendment to the charter. Acting against a framework and changing that framework are distinct matters. A precise account should also separate the colony's position from any subsequent action by the home world, which this report does not establish as having occurred.

The position of {target} warrants scrutiny through the reported defiance. This account does not presume the precise breach or announce a punitive consequence that has not been established in the report. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.

variants.headline: Charter compliance becomes an open dispute
variants.sub: The colony is openly defying its charter.
variants.body:
Charter authority is being openly defied by the colony. The stance deserves serious attention in its own right. For {target}, the question is how to judge an explicit refusal of compliance, without presuming the precise act involved or treating a possible consequence as already established.

The gazette records the defiance without assuming an amendment to the charter. Acting against a framework and changing that framework are distinct matters.
